what: Chat completion with inline mcp_servers (name, url, purpose_hint, allowed_tools) pointing at a public Receipt MCP server

error_body.detail: This workspace does not let a request name MCP servers by URL. Use a stored server through mcp_server_ids, or ask a workspace admin to allow request MCP servers.

notes: Default workspace setting blocks request-level MCP servers; docs show inline mcp_servers without mentioning the setting.
Error has no machine-readable `code` (null), unlike budget_exceeded / web_access_disabled.
